description: This file defines the NamingServiceContainer class, which manages a RMI (Remote Method Invocation) naming service in the OFBiz framework. It handles initialization, starting, and stopping of the naming registry, including configuration of host, port, and socket factory.

classes.name: NamingServiceContainer
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of an RMI naming service, including initialization, start, and stop procedures, within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container with configuration parameters such as host and port, and sets up the socket factory.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the RMI registry for the naming service.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the RMI registry if it is running.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the container instance.
